environment: Owned Chromium desktop session python-showcase; loopback static server 127.0.0.1:18214; shipped player, worker and renderer; no API or production write
scope: 3 actual source loads; each desktop run then same-page rerun, and mobile reload and run; 9 executions; covers are cropped directly from final desktop drawing area

covers.method: Playwright screenshot clip of actual final player frame, no redrawing

limitations: Not a full SPA work-detail flow or production publication check
No human acceptance or classroom trial
